The String module provides functions for string manipulation, inspection, transformations, and substring searches.

len

Signature
len(s: String) -> Int

Returns the total number of bytes/characters in a string.

Parameters:
- s: Target string to inspect.

Returns:
- Int: Total length of the string.

Usage: 
var length = "Hello World".len() # 11

concat

Signature
concat(s1: String, s2: String) -> String

Concatenates two strings together and returns the result.

Parameters:
- s1: First string segment.
- s2: Second string segment.

Returns:
- String: Combined string value.

Usage: 
var greeting = "Hello ".concat("World") # "Hello World"

upper

Signature
upper(s: String) -> String

Converts all characters in a string to uppercase.

Parameters:
- s: Input string to transform.

Returns:
- String: Uppercase string representation.

Usage: 
var loud = "hello".upper() # "HELLO"

lower

Signature
lower(s: String) -> String

Converts all characters in a string to lowercase.

Parameters:
- s: Input string to transform.

Returns:
- String: Lowercase string representation.

Usage: 
var quiet = "WORLD".lower() # "world"

substring

Signature
substring(s: String, start: Int, end: Int) -> String

Extracts a range of characters from index start up to, but excluding, end.

Parameters:
- s: Input string.
- start: Zero-based starting character index.
- end: Zero-based ending character index (exclusive).

Returns:
- String: Extracted sub-string segment.

Usage: 
var sub = "Hello World".substring(0, 5) # "Hello"

trim

Signature
trim(s: String) -> String

Strips leading and trailing whitespace characters from a string.

Parameters:
- s: Input string to trim.

Returns:
- String: Cleaned string without boundary whitespace.

Usage: 
var clean = "   hello   ".trim() # "hello"

contains

Signature
contains(s: String, needle: String) -> Bool

Checks whether a target string contains a specified substring sequence.

Parameters:
- s: Base string to search within.
- needle: Target substring to check for.

Returns:
- Bool: true if the needle substring is found, otherwise false.

Usage: 
if "banana".contains("nan") {
    # Match found
}

replace

Signature
replace(s: String, old: String, new: String) -> String

Replaces all occurrences of a target substring with a replacement string.

Parameters:
- s: Input string.
- old: Target substring pattern to find.
- new: Replacement string content.

Returns:
- String: Transformed string value.

Usage: 
var res = "foo bar".replace("bar", "baz") # "foo baz"

reverse

Signature
reverse(s: String) -> String

Reverses the character sequence of a given string.

Parameters:
- s: Input string to reverse.

Returns:
- String: Reversed string value.

Usage: 
var rev = "abc".reverse() # "cba"

starts_with

Signature
starts_with(s: String, prefix: String) -> Bool

Verifies if a string begins with the specified prefix sequence.

Parameters:
- s: Base string to inspect.
- prefix: Prefix text sequence to test.

Returns:
- Bool: true if prefix matches, false otherwise.

Usage: 
if "http://example.com".starts_with("http") {
    # URL prefix matched
}

ends_with

Signature
ends_with(s: String, suffix: String) -> Bool

Verifies if a string terminates with the specified suffix sequence.

Parameters:
- s: Base string to inspect.
- suffix: Suffix text sequence to test.

Returns:
- Bool: true if suffix matches, false otherwise.

Usage: 
if "image.png".ends_with(".png") {
    # PNG extension matched
}

index_of

Signature
index_of(s: String, needle: String) -> Int

Returns the byte index of the first occurrence of a substring.

Parameters:
- s: Base string to search within.
- needle: Target substring sequence.

Returns:
- Int: Zero-based byte index of match start, or -1 if not found.

Usage: 
var idx = "hello world".index_of("world") # 6

repeat

Signature
repeat(s: String, n: Int) -> String

Creates a string by duplicating an input string n times.

Parameters:
- s: Text payload to repeat.
- n: Number of repetitions to generate.

Returns:
- String: Repeated string sequence.

Usage: 
var echo = "ha".repeat(3) # "hahaha"

char_at

Signature
char_at(s: String, index: Int) -> String

Returns a single-character string residing at the specified zero-based character position.

Parameters:
- s: Target string.
- index: Zero-based character index.

Returns:
- String: Single-character string, or Null if the index exceeds string boundaries.

Usage: 
var ch = "Silk".char_at(0) # "S"

count

Signature
count(s: String, needle: String) -> Int

Counts the non-overlapping occurrences of a substring inside a target string.

Parameters:
- s: Base string to search within.
- needle: Target substring pattern.

Returns:
- Int: Total match count.

Usage: 
var total = "banana".count("a") # 3
